paragraphs: R' Yochanan, son of R' Yehoshua ben Korcha.
Mentioned at the beginning of Sifra, Acharei, in a halakhic passage.[^1]

notes.text: ריש אחרי gives the beginning of Acharei in Sifra, without modern numbering or independent named-edition verification. בהלכה is a halakhic passage/ruling. The complete filial chain is Hyman’s assertion; both abbreviated title components remain R'.
